_comment: SV phase-2 (semantic tier) differential cases. Per case: example dir under Examples/system-verilog/, top module, optional source-file base (file), parameter values (params; absent -> envelope defaults), clock port name (clock, default 'clk'), signals to sample, one stimulus object per cycle (input name -> MSB-first binary at the instantiated width; absent inputs hold). xrun_only: skip Icarus (it cannot parse `case inside`).
